xhs.title: Amazon's silent badge
xhs.opening_hook: Your Amazon listing might already have an invisible badge that's quietly killing your conversion.
xhs.content:
Your Amazon listing might already have an invisible badge that's quietly killing your conversion.

It's called Frequently Returned. Amazon attaches it to high-return-rate products and shows it directly on the product detail page — every shopper sees it.

Once it's on, conversion drops 20-40%.

The worst part: Amazon does not notify you. If you don't actively check, you might be wearing the badge for weeks while you keep paying for ad clicks.

Trigger conditions are simple:

* Your SKU's return rate is above the category average
* Returns concentrate around "not as described" or "quality issues"
* Post-promo return spikes push the rate over the line fast

Prime Day 2026 is roughly 5 weeks out. This is the last clean fix window.

Three things to do tonight:

1. Pull the FBA returns report. For every SKU, look at return rate and the top 3 return reasons.
2. For SKUs above the category average, fix the detail page first — real photos, sizing chart, materials, expectations. Help the buyer know what they're going to get.
3. For SKUs that are persistently broken and can't be fixed in time, pause ads or remove them before Prime Day. Don't let the event scale your problem.

This isn't a 'next quarter' problem. Once the badge sticks, you need weeks of below-average returns to remove it. Prime Day won't wait.
